name: View-Independent SH Color (Degree 0)
definition: Omits view-dependent spherical harmonics (SH) coefficients by setting the SH degree to 0, using only view-independent color.
summary: View-Independent SH Color (Degree 0) simplifies neural field rendering by fixing spherical harmonics to degree zero, producing a single RGB color per location that ignores viewing direction to reduce memory and training time at the cost of view-dependent effects.
